## Import data
```{r}

df <- read_csv("C:/Users/apmc/OneDrive - Norwegian University of Life Sciences/BatLab Norway/Projects/CoastalMonitoring/Analyses/Outputs/Reed/CombineCSV_Utsira_2026-10-27/Utsira_AllSites_combined_manualid_raw.csv")

dim(df)
# 158033     48

names(df)
#  [1] "...1"          "INDIR"         "OUTDIR"        "FOLDER"        "IN FILE"       "CHANNEL"      
#  [7] "OFFSET"        "DURATION"      "OUT FILE FS"   "OUT FILE ZC"   "DATE"          "TIME"         
# [13] "HOUR"          "DATE-12"       "TIME-12"       "HOUR-12"       "AUTO ID"       "PULSES"       
# [19] "MATCHING"      "MATCH RATIO"   "MARGIN"        "ALTERNATE 1"   "ALTERNATE 2"   "N"            
# [25] "Fc"            "Sc"            "Dur"           "Fmax"          "Fmin"          "Fmean"        
# [31] "TBC"           "Fk"            "Tk"            "S1"            "Tc"            "Qual"         
# [37] "FILES"         "MANUAL ID"     "ORGID"         "USERID"        "REVIEW ORGID"  "REVIEW USERID"
# [43] "INPATHMD5"     "OUTPATHMD5FS"  "OUTPATHMD5ZC"  "analyst"       "﻿INDIR"         "site"    

temp <- df |> select(c
                    ('IN FILE', 'OUT FILE FS', DATE, 'DATE-12', 
                      'AUTO ID', 'MANUAL ID','MATCH RATIO', analyst, site)) 


temp1 <- temp |> rename(infile = 'IN FILE',
          outfile = 'OUT FILE FS',
          night = 'DATE-12',
          autoid = 'AUTO ID',
          manualid = 'MANUAL ID',
          match.ratio = 'MATCH RATIO') |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    infile = as.character(infile), 
    outfile = as.character(outfile), 
    autoid = factor(autoid),
         manualid = factor(manualid),
         analyst = factor(analyst),
         site = factor(site))

str(temp1)
temp1 <- as.data.frame(temp1)

summary(temp1)
dim(temp1)
# 158033      9
## Now check that everything without a manual id is autoid noise 

temp2 <- temp1 |> filter(is.na(manualid)) 
dim(temp2)
# 142194      9

summary(temp2)
summary(temp2$manualid)
summary(temp2$autoid)

## NEARLY all of these are Noise... 
# BARBAR EPTNIL MYOBRA MYODAU MYOMYS MYONAT   NoID  Noise NYCNOC PIPNAT PIPPYG VESMUR 
#      0      7      0      0      0      0     30 142150      1      6      0      0 

whothis <- temp2 |> filter(autoid != "Noise")
# 44 obs 
summary(whothis)
## All of these are from CM-02 in 2026 and I was the only analyst, so something has been overlooked by me!

## I manually checked these 44 files in KPRO - they are all Noise files. 
## Now to slice and dice these files back into the main dataset with the correct manual ID. 

whothis$manualid <- "Noise"
whothis$manualid <- factor(whothis$manualid)

wholist <- whothis$outfile 
wholist
## 

temp3 <- temp1 |> dplyr::filter(!(outfile %in% wholist)) 
nrow(temp1) - nrow(temp3)
# 44 - good!

temp4 <- full_join(temp3, whothis)
dim(temp4)
summary(temp4)
# 158033      9 - good! Fixed!! Now we can move on to cleaning manual ids

#write.csv(temp4, file = file.path(output_today, "combinedUtsira_CM02_2026_errorfixed.csv"))
#4.11.2026

temp5 <- temp4 |> filter(manualid != "NA") 
#15883 obs of 9 vars

summary(temp5)
levels(temp5$manualid)
# "CNIL"   "CNIL.B" "ENIL"   "NNOC"   "NoID"   "Noise"  "NYCT"   "PNAT"   "PNAT.B" "PPYG"   "PPYG.B"

## Cleaning the manual IDs is going ot be pretty straightforward. 

DF <- temp5 |> mutate(Mid = factor(case_when(
  manualid == "CNIL" ~ "CNIL",
  manualid == "CNIL.B" ~ "CNIL",
  manualid == "ENIL" ~ "CNIL", 
  manualid == "NNOC" ~ "NNOC", 
  manualid == "NoID" ~ "NoID", 
  manualid == "Noise" ~ "Noise", 
  manualid == "NYCT" ~ "NYCT", 
  manualid == "PNAT" ~ "PNAT", 
  manualid == "PNAT.B" ~ "PNAT", 
  manualid == "PPYG" ~ "PPYG", 
  manualid == "PPYG.B" ~ "PPYG"))) |> 
  mutate(behavior = factor(case_when(
    str_detect(manualid, ".B") ~ "Feeding",
    TRUE ~ "Commuting"
  )))

24/15859 # .15% feeding buzzes
14599/15859 # 92% were classified as Noise
15859-14599
summary(DF)

# write.csv(DF, file= file.path(output_today, "Utsira_ManualID_cleaned.csv"))

```


# Important summary notes for DF - Utsira cleaned and combined 

15883 files were manually verified by 3 different analyses (BØ = 5095, MZ = 927, RAM = 4485) across 3 different sites (CM-01 = 10471, CM-02 = 927, UT-01 = 4485). Only 24 of the recordings (.15%) included feeding buzzes, the rest were classified as commuting passes. There were 1260 recordings that were verified as bat passes, the rest (14599, 92%) were classified as Noise.
